rule: every row is a CONSERVATIVE PATH UPPER BOUND on executed instructions per call: acyclic symbols are bounded by their static length (no simple path repeats an instruction), loop-bearing symbols by body x trip count plus the remainder. Branch targets are matched for Darwin LBB and ELF .L spellings. No row asserts static == executed.

_fmul.method: acyclic: static length is an upper bound on every path

_v15o_label.method: acyclic: static length is an upper bound on every path

_rmont.method: acyclic: static length is an upper bound on every path

_v15o_report.method: acyclic: static length is an upper bound on every path

scalar_detector: the vectoriser is OFF for the counted TU, so _v15o_detect carries no SIMD op and no SIMD-to-scalar translation is needed anywhere
